hero.title: Green Pi Energy
hero.subtitle: Creating solutions — not just selling products. Engineering-led power distribution and renewable energy partnerships, built for long-term growth with TE Connectivity in Türkiye.

about.founderAlt: Serhat Çelik, Founder of Green Pi Energy
about.title: Engineering expertise, commercial capability, long-term relationships
about.body: Founded by Serhat Çelik on 2 August 2023, Green Pi Energy operates in Low Voltage, Medium Voltage, power distribution, and renewable energy — guided by a single principle: creating solutions rather than simply selling products. As of July 2026, Green Pi expanded into software and information technology, and on 12 December 2024, Green Pi Agriculture & Livestock commenced operations in Sarıkaya, Yozgat. The wider Green Pi group now spans energy, engineering, technology, software, and agriculture.

partners.title: Our Brand Portfolio & Strategic Partnerships
partners.body: Green Pi Energy combines distribution, authorized dealership, product representation, engineering support, and project-based partnerships — bringing together international brands and local market knowledge to deliver the most appropriate solution for each customer and application.

process.title: Solutions, not just products
process.body: For every project, our objective is not only to determine which product the customer should purchase, but also to evaluate the most suitable system architecture, protection philosophy, communication infrastructure, and future expansion — positioning Green Pi as a long-term engineering partner, not merely an equipment supplier.
process.step1Body: Establish more than €500,000 in annual purchasing agreements for TE Connectivity products during the first year of cooperation.
process.step2Body: Move beyond individual orders by integrating TE Connectivity components into BOM lists, standard panel designs, and annual purchasing programs.
process.step3Body: Build a permanent, growing market through local stock, technical support, sub-distributor development, and joint marketing initiatives.
process.targetOemsIntro: In the first phase, Green Pi aims to integrate TE Connectivity into the BOM lists, standard panel designs, and annual purchasing programs of major manufacturers, including:
process.visionBody: Green Pi Energy's long-term objective is to become an international solution company that brings together energy, engineering, technology, and digitalization under one roof — expanding engineering, product supply, system integration, and project development activities across Europe, the Middle East, the Caucasus, and surrounding markets.

growth.title: A 5-year growth strategy, planned by product group
growth.intro: We see the business model we aim to build with TE Connectivity not as a short-term sales target, but as a five-year growth strategy planned and measured at the product-group level. Green Pi Energy's goal is to build a sustainable structure in the Turkish market for TE Connectivity's Terminal Blocks, Relays, ESSAILEC, and Measurement & Monitoring product groups — integrating TE Connectivity products into the standard product lists of major OEM manufacturers, and over time bringing new TE Connectivity products into the Turkish market.
growth.introNote: The figures presented here should be understood as strategic sales targets, not a sales forecast. Our goal is not simply to reach a given sales volume, but to build a long-term, scalable market in Türkiye together with TE Connectivity.
growth.tableNote: In this distribution, Terminal Blocks is positioned as the primary volume product group given its broad OEM and panel-builder customer base. Relays represents the second major growth area, while ESSAILEC is targeted for development particularly in energy, protection, measurement, utility and substation applications. For Measurement, Monitoring and other strategic TE Connectivity product groups, growth will be supported by identifying suitable new products from TE Connectivity's global portfolio for the Turkish market.

growth.objectiveQuote: Our objective is not simply to achieve €8 million in sales. Our objective is to build a sustainable TE Connectivity market in Türkiye.
growth.objectiveBody: We aim to build a market where TE Connectivity products become the standard, preferred choice among OEM manufacturers, panel builders, EPC companies, energy companies and major industrial customers.
growth.objectiveClosing: Green Pi Energy's long-term goal: to create demand, develop the market and build sustainable growth for TE Connectivity in Türkiye.

opportunities.title: Market Development Opportunities for TE Connectivity in Türkiye
opportunities.body: Based on Green Pi's direct interaction with manufacturers, panel builders, engineering companies and end users, we see significant growth potential — and several areas where a stronger local structure could convert TE Connectivity's global product strength into greater market penetration.

events.title: From 2026 Onward: A Golf Sponsorship & Partnership Vision
events.body: As Green Pi Energy, we support events that bring sports and business together by sponsoring a tournament at Ankara Golf Club in 2026. In the coming years, we aim to grow this step into joint sponsorships with TE Connectivity — building a collaboration that strengthens the visibility of both brands, lays the groundwork for new business relationships, and contributes to sport over the long term.
